description.name: Entry
description.text:
Master Mode, Instant ATB 1 & Diffusion Barrier 1 to user
Master Mode: Cap Break Level 2, Hero Boost +25%, Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast; If target has DEF/RES/MND buff, chases with AOE DEF/RES/MND -50% for 8 seconds (max 1 chase)
Interval Chase: 10 single-target Water/NE summon magic attacks, 50 SB Charge, Hero Boost +30/35/40/45/50% to user after 1/2/3/4/5 chases (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Water/NE piercing summon magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, removes Master Mode
